- **CRITICAL** · Precharge + weld check via Kelly CAN B+ (room DECIDED 2026-10-23: chief + Sparky + crew; replaces the isolated HV_SENSE on A:24, AMC1311 DROPPED for now; docs only, firmware NOT changed in Build 18): bus side = Kelly CAN B+, pack side = BICM cell sum. (a) Close Main+ only when Kelly B+ >= 95% of the BICM sum AND the minimum precharge time has passed; time alone never closes it. (b) A stale (>200 ms) or missing Kelly frame = precharge FAIL: mains open, fault. (c) Sequence (chief DECIDED 2026-10-23; KSI open item RESOLVED: e-stop block 2 only passes power, the Teensy drives the precharge coil separately, so KSI comes on first): 1) key on, KSI on; 2) a fresh Kelly B+ frame reads ~0 V (else Main+ welded); 3) close Main- alone, B+ still ~0 V (else Main+ welded); 4) precharge; 5) close Main+ only when B+ >= 95% of the BICM sum AND the minimum time has passed (a Main- weld shows up when Main+ closes). Second layer: key-off check (open Main+, hold KSI ~3 s; B+ still tracking the BICM sum = welded). Firmware TODO (needs chief + Sparky + Mechanic): PrechargeGate already has the 95% + min-time rule, but its bus input is HV_SENSE (HV_ANALOG_ENABLE=0 -> always FAIL today); it must take Kelly B+ with the 200 ms staleness rule.
